description: France e-invoicing reform by company size: every business must be able to receive e-invoices from 1 September 2026; issuing and e-reporting from 1 September 2026 for grandes entreprises and ETI, by 1 September 2027 for PME and micro-entreprises. Scope: B2B between VAT-registered businesses established in France. Size thresholds and penalties are not computed. France (service-public, impots.gouv FAQ), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: not tax advice, no filing, no software certification.
